summary: Iteration 119 regression: verified hook-dependency refactor (AuthContext/CartContext useCallback, refs in ChatWidget/OrdersPage/CatalogPage/ProductPage/BonusPage/AdminChatsPage/CRMTab/FavoritesButton/RelatedProducts), moved /api/rewards/cart-preview endpoint, new Garage-in-finder feature, and new admin mobile drawer. All backend and frontend regression checks passed. No page errors, no infinite request loops, no 'Cannot access ... before initialization' crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: pickVehicle in PartsFinderPage splits vehicle.name by first whitespace to derive brand/model. If a user enters a single-word name, model will be empty. Acceptable fallback behavior but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ garage vehicle for user@demo.com (VIN WMA06XZZ7KP123456) and deleted it at end of test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter119_regression.py covers moved /api/rewards/cart-preview endpoint + sanity (auth/me, cart, orders, products, bonus/programs). Hook refactor regression verified on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x800). Parts-finder garage select works: picking a vehicle fills VIN/brand/model/year inputs. Admin mobile drawer: hamburger opens admin-mobile-drawer with the 5 collapsible groups (sales/catalog/clients/marketing/system), orders/chats top links, mobile-admin-logout; tapping a nav item navigates and closes drawer; no horizontal overflow. Session persistence + corrupt-token 401 logout verified. Network polling verified: /api/orders fired ~3x in 20s on /orders page (matches 15s interval, counter double-counted /orders and /orders/stats both containing substring).
